title: Community forum
description: Public forum where your customers ask questions and answer each other. Every post is approved here before it is published.
forbidden: You do not have permission to manage the forum. Ask your organization admin for the feedback management permission.
error.title: Could not load the forum
error.description: Refresh the page and try again.
moderation.empty: No posts are waiting for approval.

categories.hint: Visitors pick one of these categories when they open a topic.

categories.dialog_hint: The category address cannot be changed once published.
categories.name: Category name
categories.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Example: billing-and-payments
topics.columns.title: Topic
topics.hint: Only published topics are listed, as visitors see them. Changes may take up to 30 seconds to show.
topics.more_replies: Showing the first 100 replies; all of them are on the public page.
topics.to_conversation_hint: Opens a conversation with the topic's author in the selected inbox, assigned to you. If the topic was converted before, that conversation opens.
share.button: Add to the forum as a question
share.title: Add to the forum as a question

share.question: Question title
share.body_hint: Remove personal data (names, emails, order numbers…); this text may be published.

toast.category_exists: A category with this address already exists.

toast.already_shared: This conversation is already linked to a forum topic.
